entries.name: Image generation
entries.definition: Creating new images from text prompts or other inputs with generative AI models.

entries.name: Image segmentation
entries.definition: Dividing a digital image into regions, such as separating objects from the background, so that each part can be analysed.

entries.name: Imaging informatics
entries.definition: The field that applies information technology to medical images, covering how they are acquired, stored, shared and analysed.

entries.name: Immunization
entries.definition: The use of vaccines to make people resistant to specific infectious diseases, including which vaccines are given, when and to whom.

entries.name: Immunohaematology
entries.definition: The branch of laboratory medicine that studies blood-group antigens and antibodies, used for blood typing and for matching blood before a transfusion.

entries.name: Immutable.js
entries.definition: A JavaScript library from Facebook that provides persistent immutable data structures such as List, Map and Set.

entries.name: Impact.js
entries.definition: A JavaScript game engine for making 2D games that run in the browser on the HTML5 canvas.

entries.name: In-memory database
entries.definition: A database management system that keeps its data mainly in a computer's main memory instead of on disk, to give faster access.

entries.name: Inbound logistics
entries.definition: The part of logistics that brings materials, parts and goods from suppliers into a business, including purchasing, transport, receiving and storage.

entries.name: Incentive spirometry
entries.definition: A breathing exercise in which a patient inhales deeply through a handheld device that shows how much air is drawn in, to keep the lungs expanded and help prevent complications such as pneumonia after surgery.

entries.name: Incident reporting
entries.definition: Writing a factual, timely record of an accident, injury, security event or other incident, including what happened, who was involved and what was done.

entries.name: Incurred but not reported
entries.definition: In insurance, the estimated cost of claims for events that have already happened but have not yet been reported to or settled by the insurer.

entries.name: Indentation hardness
entries.definition: A measure of how well a material resists being permanently dented by a hard point pressed into it, found with tests such as Brinell, Vickers and Rockwell.

entries.name: IndexedDB
entries.definition: A database built into web browsers, used from JavaScript to store large amounts of structured data on the user's device.

entries.name: Individual life insurance
entries.definition: Life insurance bought by one person for themselves, rather than as group cover through an employer, that pays a benefit to named beneficiaries on death.

entries.name: Individualized Education Program
entries.definition: In the United States, the written plan required by special-education law that sets out the learning goals and support for a student with a disability.

entries.name: Individualized Family Service Plan
entries.definition: In the United States, the written plan for an infant or toddler with a developmental delay that sets out early-intervention services for the child and family.

entries.name: Industrial Internet of Things
entries.definition: Internet-connected sensors, machines and control systems in industry that collect and share data to monitor and improve operations.

entries.name: Industrial statistics
entries.definition: The use of statistical methods in industry, such as quality control, design of experiments and reliability analysis, to improve production and products.

entries.name: Infant development
entries.definition: How babies grow and change in their first years, including physical, thinking, language and social development.

entries.name: Influencing
entries.definition: Persuading other people to adopt an idea or take action without relying on formal authority.

entries.name: InfluxDB
entries.definition: An open-source time-series database from InfluxData for storing and querying timestamped data such as metrics and events.

entries.name: Infoblox IPAM
entries.definition: IP address management software from Infoblox that tracks and administers an organisation's IP address space along with its DNS and DHCP records.

entries.name: Infographics
entries.definition: Designing infographics, which present information or data visually through illustration, charts and short text.

entries.name: Information, advice and guidance
entries.definition: In the United Kingdom, helping people choose learning and career options by giving them impartial information, advice and guidance.

entries.name: Information evaluation
entries.definition: Judging the accuracy, relevance and reliability of information and its sources.

entries.name: Information hiding
entries.definition: A software design principle in which a module keeps its internal details private behind a stable interface, so changes inside it do not affect the rest of the program.

entries.name: Information leak prevention
entries.definition: Stopping sensitive information from leaving an organisation without permission, using policies, training and technical controls such as data loss prevention software.

entries.name: Information technology audit
entries.definition: Examining an organisation's IT systems, controls and processes to judge whether they protect assets, keep data accurate and follow policy and regulation.

entries.name: InFusion Enterprise Control System
entries.definition: An industrial control and operations software product from Invensys, later part of Schneider Electric.

entries.name: Ingredient functionality
entries.definition: The role an ingredient plays in a food or other formulation, such as binding, thickening, emulsifying, sweetening or preserving.

entries.name: Ingres
entries.definition: A relational database management system that began as a University of California, Berkeley research project and was later developed commercially by Ingres Corporation and then Actian.

entries.name: InnoDB
entries.definition: A storage engine for the MySQL database server that supports transactions, row-level locking and foreign keys.

entries.name: Inpatient obstetric nursing
entries.definition: Caring for women in hospital during pregnancy complications, labour, delivery and the days after birth.

entries.name: Inside sales management
entries.definition: Leading a team that sells to customers by phone, email and online rather than face to face, including coaching staff and meeting sales targets.

entries.name: InsightVM
entries.definition: Rapid7's vulnerability management software, which scans systems for security weaknesses and helps prioritise fixes.

entries.name: Instagram
entries.definition: A social media platform, owned by Meta, for sharing photos and short videos.

entries.name: Instagram advertising
entries.definition: Creating, targeting and managing paid ads on Instagram through Meta's advertising tools.

entries.name: Instagram content creation
entries.definition: Planning and making posts, stories, reels and captions for an Instagram account.

entries.name: Instagram marketing
entries.definition: Promoting a brand or product on Instagram through content, community engagement, influencer partnerships and ads.
